user.title: Xiaomi MIoT Camera Setup
user.description:
Click submit to start setting up your Xiaomi cameras.

Note: This integration requires the 'Xiaomi Camera Proxy' Add-on to be installed and running.

auth.title: Xiaomi Account Login
auth.description:
Please login to your Xiaomi account:

**Step 1:** Click the link below to open Xiaomi login page:
[Open Login Page]({auth_url})

**Step 2:** Login with your Xiaomi account and authorize.

**Step 3:** After authorization, you will see a page with a Base64 string. Copy the entire string.

**Step 4:** Paste the Base64 string below and click Submit.

auth_manual.title: Manual Token Input
auth_manual.description: Enter your Xiaomi OAuth tokens manually.

cameras.title: Select Cameras
cameras.description: Found {camera_count} camera(s). Select the cameras you want to add to Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Camera Proxy Add-on or Xiaomi cloud service
error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication. Please check your credentials and try again.
error.invalid_oauth_result: Invalid OAuth result. Please make sure you copied the complete Base64 string.

abort.no_cameras: No cameras found in your Xiaomi account
abort.addon_not_available: Camera Proxy Add-on is not available. Please install it from: {addon_url}

init.description:
Configure your Xiaomi MIoT Camera integration.
